subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, A, B, C, D, E, F and O, are sitting in a row facing north. Only two people sit to the left of F. Only three people sit between F and A. Only one person sits between A and O. D sits to the immediate left of C. E is not an immediate neighbour of A. How many people sit to the right of B?
solution:
Given:

Seven friends, A, B, C, D, E, F and O, are sitting in a row facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of F. Only three people sit between F and A.

Only one person sits between A and O. D sits to the immediate left of C.

E is not an immediate neighbour of A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6f5639610dc0ccf89d4301fd30c0ad8e31846ea641bd28a768ecd75ea4ebf38.png] 

Thus, 1 people sit to the right of B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
